findings.title: Assigned surface docs/build does not exist in the round's ground truth — dead lane, not a clean one
findings.description: The lane brief designates `/tmp/jl_XGd0LR/docs/build` as the surface to audit ('read every API page's rendered content'), but that directory does not exist anywhere under the ground-truth root, and no `.html` file exists anywhere in `/tmp/jl_XGd0LR`. No @docs/@autodocs block's rendered content, no API page's built prose, and none of the HTML-only defect classes this lane exists to catch (base-URL leaks, rendered-markup asterisks surviving CommonMark, stray unrendered math, cross-links resolving to the wrong anchor, the public-home scan's target) can be inspected from this ground truth. Per the package's own RULE.TEST.MISSING_IS_FAILING ('the missing case is the failing case... a zero count is a dead lane rather than a clean one') and RULE.INST.SELF_REPORT ('a zero count is a dead lane rather than a clean hat'), an empty findings list here is not evidence the built HTML is clean — it is evidence the built HTML was never produced for this round's snapshot. Inspection of docs/make.jl and the Documenter extension shows a plausible mechanism consistent with this: GBGCodingToolsDocumenterExt.makedocs prints 'makedocs: SKIPPED' and returns `nothing` without calling `Documenter.makedocs` whenever a check-docs or check-consistency round is open at build time (RULE.INST.FROZEN_MIDROUND) — i.e. the very round this lane serves may itself be the reason no fresh docs/build was ever written into this round's ground-truth snapshot. This is reported as a self-containment/coverage defect of the round's ground truth, not of the package's source prose, and should not be scored as 'built-html surface reviewed clean.'
findings.resolution_hint: Either (a) populate the ground-truth root with a docs/build produced with GBG_DOCS_NO_SKIP=1 (or produced before the review round opened) so this lane has an actual surface to audit, or (b) if the built-HTML lane is meant to be structurally unable to run while a check-docs round is open, say so explicitly in the lane brief and drop it from the battery for such rounds rather than presenting it as a normal lane with a normal 'clean' result.
